item.tib: klong rgyas kyi thig mtshon kho na'i 'grel ba g.yung drung bkod legs kyi rgyan
item.coloph: de ltar klong rgyas kyi thig mtshon kho na'i 'bru don gsal bar byed pa g.yung drung bkod legs kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson shes rab kyi rgyan dang / bstan pa sgo btsan pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dbra ston nam mkha' rin chen (gyis) brag dmar gyi gnas su klong rgyas kyi thig 'tshams (thun mtshams) la sbyor ba dge'o//
